That’s a lot of work before 9 a.m. — crying it out in the car, wiping your face, and walking in with “good morning” like nothing happened. That’s not nothing. That’s a performance you’ve gotten very good at.

And it’s the same move as the driveway, isn’t it? Swallow it, keep the surface calm, protect everyone from the weight of it. With him, it reads as a closed door. At work, nobody sees it at all.

Can I ask — what are the mornings about? Is it the relationship, the job, or just the accumulation of holding everything in? And is there anyone at all — not necessarily him — who you don’t have to wipe your face for?
